build_plane_from_normal_and_point: build a plane parameterization from a normal vector and a point using Geometry.vec_and_point_to_plane
calculate_distance_point_to_plane: calculate the shortest distance between a plane and external points using Geometry.distance_point_plane
convert_ase_cell_to_planes: convert an ASE cell to six bounding plane parameterizations using Geometry.cell2planes with periodic boundary conditions
extract_box_properties_from_corners: extract all box properties from any two of center, length, lo_corner, or hi_corner using Geometry.extract_box_properties
generate_packmol_structure_for_box: generate a packmol input structure string for solvent molecules inside or outside a BoxGeometry
